purpose: Proposed Native4 child-only restart for persisted revision/identity and heartbeat recovery verification.

restart_strategy_finding.evidence: supervisor.py only creates asyncio TCP server and awaits proxy.connection/serve_forever; it does not Popen or monitor the Agent. Child PPID is PID 1.
restart_strategy_finding.consequence: Restart=on-failure applies to MainPID 32487, not child PID 47015; stopping/restarting this Unit risks all processes in the shared cgroup and is prohibited. No existing child-only auto-respawner was found.

heartbeat_evidence.interpretation: Historical log keyword matches and current API last_seen are not packet-level heartbeat capture. A future restart check should record a new connection event plus a successful sync_ack at/after the persisted revision and an advancing Hub last_seen; this remains a real behavior oracle, not source inference.

conditional_validation_steps_if_root_aut: Before acting, repeat exact owner/PID/startticks/UID/argv-config-path/exeSHA/cgroup, Unit, DB-inode/identity/revision and API health guards.
Do not stop/restart the parent Unit or cgroup. Do not use killall or process-name matching.
Use only an explicitly approved child-only restart mechanism; current environment has no verified mechanism that recreates PID 47015 after SIGTERM.
If a mechanism is approved, signal only the exact owned child PID after the approved guard; preserve root/config/binary/Node/Agent identity.
Within <=30s require old PID gone and a different PID with UID65534, same d55 SHA/config path/root/DB inode and a distinct child restart observation; leave supervisor PID44932 unchanged.
Require the local global revision not to regress, DB quick_check ok and exact Node/Agent identity unchanged.

Require repair API online/synced, same IDs, advancing last_seen, and a new proxy connection+successful sync_ack covering the persisted revision; if absent, report failure/partial, never infer from source.
Recheck original 4 Agents and parent service remain healthy; exact read-only helper Task DELETE/GET404; preserve Execution/Audit history.
decision: Explicit Root approval supplied a dedicated one-child manual SIGTERM/Popen recipe. It was executed with exact process/data guards; the parent Unit/cgroup and proxy were preserved.
